summary: Iteration 14: Quick Visit Feature Testing. Backend: 9/9 tests PASSED. Frontend: Quick Visit FAB renders correctly on both landmarks list page and landmark detail page. Fixed bug: onSuccess callback in landmark-detail was referencing undefined function 'fetchLandmarkDetail' instead of 'fetchLandmark'.

issues: Page gets stuck on 'Loading amazing destinations...' skeleton when navigating from continents. API returns data but page doesn't render countries list. This appears to be a pre-existing issue, not related to Quick Visit feature.

critical_code_review_comments: ESLint shows TypeScript 'interface' keyword errors but these are false positives - ESLint config not recognizing .tsx files properly. Code compiles and runs correctly with Expo/Metro.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - Quick Visit FAB renders on both landmarks list and landmark detail pages

seed_data_creation: Visits created and deleted during test (automated cleanup)

Note: explore-countries page has pre-existing loading issue not related to this feature.
